title: Write an evidence-based generalization plan
mission: Write an evidence-based generalization plan using the lesson interactions and accepted prior evidence.

starting_state.known_good_state: The lesson interactions load and the prior contract is available.

guided.objective: Complete the supported activity path and record observable evidence.
guided.expected_observation: The control responds to observed evidence rather than habit.

challenge.objective: Compare two controls under fixed evaluation boundaries.
steps: Predict the result before changing the scenario
challenge.expected_observation: Only the control matching the failure improves held-out evidence.

engineer_extension.objective: Add shift monitoring, slices, and seed uncertainty.
engineer_extension.expected_observation: Release evidence covers robustness and change.

failure_experiment.failure_signal: Validation degrades on the intended task

acceptance_criteria: The control responds to observed evidence rather than habit.
Only the control matching the failure improves held-out evidence.
The artifact identifies its downstream consumer and recovery behavior.
recovery: Return to the lesson's known-good scenario before comparing another change.
